answer: Work waits on the nebula until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the sable of the next round. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the oasis of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. The design leans on per-epoch sampling audit, diluted when peers disagree, each submission carries a fresh nonce. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit.
